prompt: Write the lyrics of a country song about leaving a small town. Output only the lyrics.
raw:
**[Verse 1]**  
Dust on the dashboard, same sky I’ve always known  
Counting fence posts one last time, this gravel road I’ve grown  
Mama’s at the screen door, crying dry-eyed in the porch light  
I left my heart on Main Street in the rear-view mirror tonight  

**[Chorus]**  
Tail lights on the horizon, burning out small  
Gonna chase down tomorrow where the wild winds call  
Yeah, the highway takes its time, but I’m taking it all  
Leaving this small town, learning how to fall  

**[Verse 2]**  
Thirty miles of nothing, radio fading out  
Suitcase full of maybes, pockets full of doubt  
But the city’s got a promise that these fields never made  
I’m trading Friday football for a neon, brighter day  

**[Chorus]**  
Tail lights on the horizon, burning out small  
Gonna chase down tomorrow where the wild winds call  
Yeah, the highway takes its time, but I’m taking it all  
Leaving this small town, learning how to fall  

**[Bridge]**  
I’ll miss the sound of Sunday bells  
The way the harvest moon would tell  
Secrets that the harvest never tells  
But I’ve got a one-way ticket to myself  

**[Verse 3]**  
Topographic tan lines, different time zone soon  
Hear that diesel engine humming like a different tune  
I’m a ghost in my hometown before I’m even gone  
But I’ll be back at Christmas if the money holds on  

**[Chorus]**  
Tail lights on the horizon, burning out small  
Gonna chase down tomorrow where the wild winds call  
Yeah, the highway takes its time, but I’m taking it all  
Leaving this small town, learning how to fall  

**[Outro]**  
Learning how to fall…  
Into something bigger than us all  
Leaving this small town  
(Engine fades out)  
Leaving this small town
